content_units: Best-Value Pick for Barcelona Family Stay

For your priorities—  stay under 1100 EUR  ,   breakfast included  , and   easy metro access  —  Option A is the best overall value  . It meets every core requirement, stays comfortably under budget, and gives you a proper family room without paying extra for features you did not prioritize.
Barcelona Hotel Ranking
Option   Total Price   Breakfast   Metro Access   Room Fit   Best-Value Verdict
A       980 EUR     Included   9-min walk   Family room      1 Best overall balance
D       1040 EUR     Included   14-min walk   Double + rollaway bed      2 Acceptable but weaker convenience
B       1125 EUR     Included   3-min walk   Family room      3 Best comfort/location, but over budget
C       890 EUR     Not included   6-min walk   Family room      4 Low sticker price, but misses a key requirement
1) Option A
-   Why it ranks first:   It fits your budget, includes breakfast, and has a   family room  , which is better for a 2 adults + 1 child setup than a rollaway arrangement.
-   Metro access:   A   9-minute walk   is still reasonably convenient in Barcelona.
-   Value call:   You save   120 EUR vs D   and   145 EUR vs B  , while still matching your must-haves.
Choose A
2) Option D
-   Why it ranks second:   It is within budget and includes breakfast.
-   Main drawback:     14-minute walk to metro   is notably less convenient, especially with a child and daily sightseeing.
-   Room trade-off:   A   double room plus rollaway bed   is usually less comfortable than a true family room.
3) Option B
-   Why it ranks third:   This is the strongest on convenience and amenities—  3-minute metro walk  , breakfast included, family room, and rooftop pool.
-   Why it is not the best choice:   It is   25 EUR over your stated max budget  , so it fails a major constraint.
-   When to choose it anyway:   Only if the rooftop pool and much easier transit access are worth stretching the budget.
4) Option C
-   Why it ranks fourth:   The base rate looks attractive and metro access is decent at   6 minutes  .
-   Main issue:     Breakfast is not included  , which is one of your stated needs.
-   Likely outcome:   Once breakfast is added for 3 people over 4 nights, the total value advantage may shrink sharply or disappear.
Budget Fit and Decision Logic
Priority check
-   Budget max 1100 EUR:   A and D pass, B fails, C passes base price only
-   Breakfast included:   A, B, D pass; C fails
-   Easy metro access:   B is best, C good, A acceptable, D weakest
-   Family comfort:   A, B, C have family rooms; D is less ideal
Best recommendation
Choose Option A   if you want the best blend of:
- budget compliance
- breakfast included
- family-friendly room setup
- reasonable metro convenience
Trade-off alternative
Choose Option B   only if you are willing to go slightly over budget for:
- much easier metro access
- rooftop pool
- strongest overall comfort/convenience package
Booking Context for This Ranking
This ranking assumes:
- “Easy metro access” means roughly   under 10 minutes on foot   is good, and over that starts to reduce convenience for a family trip.
- Breakfast for Option C would add enough extra cost to weaken its headline price advantage.
- A   family room   is meaningfully better than a   double + rollaway   for a 4-night stay.
